cues: Industry makes alcohols on a huge scale.

In the oxo process, an alkene, carbon monoxide and hydrogen pass over a cobalt carbonyl catalyst at about a hundred and fifty degrees and a hundred atmospheres, giving an aldehyde, which is then hydrogenated.
The chain grows by one carbon: ethene gives propan one ol.
